title: Nudge sync: Map hint key to note title, value to content
description: Within a component/thread, each hint key becomes a note title, and the value becomes note content. Example: 'nudge get minerva run' → note titled 'run' with content 'Open src/project.godot in Godot 4.4, press F5'

title: Lasso tool has no visual feedback during selection
description: When drawing with the lasso selection tool, there is no visual feedback showing the path being drawn. Users cannot see what area they are selecting.

title: Co-Browser Integration: Add CoBrowserMCPClient for web automation
Nudge sync: Map components to note threads/tabs
description: When pulling from Nudge, each component should map to a note thread/tab. For example, 'minerva' component creates a 'minerva' tab in the notes pane. Find or create threads based on component name.

title: Rectangle selection tool missing left/top marching ants
description: When creating a rectangle selection, the marching ants preview doesn't show on the left and top edges of the rectangle.

title: Nudge Integration: Bidirectional Notes sync with Nudge MCP
MCP Panel UI: Central management panel for MCP servers
Drawing area should start in top-left of viewport
description: When opening the Graphics Editor, the drawing area starts centered in the viewport, wasting vertical space. Change the initial position so the drawing area starts in the top-left corner of the viewport instead.

title: Image generation timeout (120s insufficient)
description: Found in Rogers7. Image generation timed out waiting for pass_image_to_editor signal. Root cause: Fixed 120s timeout doesn't account for slow generation backends or complex prompts. Fix: Increase timeout to 180s or 300s, make configurable in settings, consider progress callbacks.

title: Note composition timeout despite signal received
description: Found in Rogers7. Log shows 'Note ready for chat signal received' immediately followed by 'Timeout waiting for note to be ready'. Root cause: State bug in Editor.gd toggle/proxy lifecycle. When toggle is already ON, calling toggle(true) doesn't emit note_ready_for_chat. The 0.5s cleanup delay may not be sufficient. Fix: Add explicit toggle state check, ensure toggle(false) fully cleans up proxy before toggle(true), consider fresh proxy each iteration.

title: Spreadsheet Phase 8: Polish & Testing
description: Theme integration (dark/light/windows modes), keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+B, Ctrl+I, etc.), performance optimization for large datasets (1000+ rows), error handling and user feedback, manual testing all features, LLM integration testing.

title: Rectangle Selection Tool - click-drag to select rectangular regions
description: Add a Rectangle Selection Tool to the Graphics Editor that allows users to select rectangular regions by click-dragging. Should support the same selection modes as Magic Wand (Replace/Add/Subtract/Intersect via Shift/Alt/Ctrl+Shift modifiers). Add to ToolsOptionButton dropdown alongside Magic Wand.

title: Add MediaGen.send_controlnet_request() for backend integration
Spreadsheet Phase 5: File Operations
description: Native JSON serialization (.minsheet), CSV import/export, TSV import/export, Excel .xlsx import (read sheet data, basic formatting), Excel .xlsx export (write sheet data, basic formatting), project save/load integration (vboxEditor.gd), import dialog with preview.

title: Nudge sync: Update push logic to use thread name as component, note title as key
description: When pushing notes to Nudge: thread/tab name becomes component, note title becomes key, note content becomes value. Restore metadata from stored nudge_hint if available.

title: Selection Mode UI Indicator
description: Add a visual indicator in the toolbar or status area showing the current selection mode (Replace/Add/Subtract/Intersect). Currently users must remember which modifier keys they're holding. Could be a small label or icon that updates based on modifier key state.

title: Create PoseOverlay.gd - skeleton visualization with bones and joints
Lasso Selection Tool - freehand selection
description: Add a Lasso Selection Tool for freehand selection by drawing around an area. Similar to Photoshop's lasso tool. Lower priority than rectangle selection. Should support same selection modes via keyboard modifiers.

title: MCP Core Framework: Create MCPManager singleton and base classes
Lasso tool performance is poor
description: The lasso selection tool has poor performance: slow to start marching ants after completing selection, and difficult to change/modify selections. Selection operation appears to freeze the UI briefly.

title: Selection tools don't update mouse cursor correctly
description: All selection tools (Magic Wand, Rectangle Select, Lasso Select) don't update the mouse cursor correctly when switching between tools.

title: Add control layer management to GraphicsEditorV2 - container, selection array, signals
Agentic Chat: Add tool call support to providers and chat loop
Non-iterative tool provides unlimited bypass
description: Found in Rogers7. LLM switched to minerva_graphics_generate (non-iterative) after hitting iterative limit. Root cause: Non-iterative tool has no limits and LLM learned to use it as bypass. User decision: Keep unlimited, rely on global 10-round limit as backstop.

title: Spreadsheet Phase 4: Formatting & Freeze Panes
description: Toolbar with formatting buttons, bold/italic/text color/background color, text alignment (left/center/right), header row designation with auto-styling, freeze rows (keep visible while scrolling), freeze columns (keep visible while scrolling), frozen pane visual separator.

title: Ghost image evaluation from non-iterative tool
description: Found in Rogers7. LLM evaluated criteria against image that wasn't visible (blank/old image in context). Root cause: minerva_graphics_generate (non-iterative) doesn't toggle 'Send to LLM' or wait for note creation. Images never appear in LLM context. Fix: Add warning to non-iterative tool, consider making it enable Send to LLM in agentic mode, add validation that image is in context before evaluation.

title: Spreadsheet Phase 2: Selection, Editing & History
description: Range selection (Shift+Click, Shift+Arrow, drag), multi-cell selection (Ctrl+Click), copy/paste improvements, undo/redo system (Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Y), column/row resize handles, auto-fit column width.

title: Create PoseEditorTool.gd - drag joints to edit pose
Spreadsheet Phase 6: Chart System
description: SpreadsheetChart data structure, line chart rendering with date X-axis, bar chart rendering, auto-scaling axes with tick marks, legend rendering, chart configuration dialog, chart panel (collapsible below spreadsheet), multiple charts per spreadsheet.

title: Integrate Graphics Editor undo with global undo button
description: The Minerva UI has a global undo button and Ctrl+Z shortcut. Currently, Graphics Editor undo is separate. Integrate them so that: 1) The global undo button triggers undo in the Graphics Editor when it's active, 2) Ctrl+Z works consistently whether focused on the editor or not.

title: Add ControlNet settings panel to ImageGenWindow
Nudge sync: Preserve hint metadata for lossless round-trip
description: Store full nudge hint structure (version, meta tags, timestamps, etc.) in note metadata via set_meta('nudge_hint', {...}). This allows pushing back to nudge without losing information.

title: Spreadsheet Phase 3: Formula Engine
description: Formula parser (tokenizer + AST), cell reference parsing (A1, $A$1, A1:B10), basic operators (+, -, *, /, ^, %), core functions (SUM, AVERAGE, COUNT, MIN, MAX), additional functions (IF, ABS, ROUND), dependency tracking for recalculation, circular reference detection, formula bar display.

title: Add CONTROL layer type to LayerV2 with control_type, pose_data, control_strength properties
LLM ignores 'new editor won't help' warning
description: Found in Rogers7. LLM created new editor despite warning that it wouldn't bypass iteration limit. Root cause: Warning messages don't stop LLMs - they need hard blocks or tool unavailability. Fix: Consider disabling minerva_create_editor tool after iteration limit reached, or return error from create_editor if limit exceeded.

title: Spreadsheet Phase 7: MCP Integration
description: Register 9 spreadsheet MCP tools: minerva_create_spreadsheet_editor, minerva_get_spreadsheet_data (JSON/CSV/markdown), minerva_update_spreadsheet_data, minerva_add_spreadsheet_row, minerva_add_spreadsheet_column, minerva_format_cells, minerva_set_cell_formula, minerva_create_chart, minerva_get_chart_image (base64 PNG). Enables LLM to create, populate, and query spreadsheets.

title: Fix Nudge MCP connection: port, endpoint, JSON-RPC format, auto-start
Create PoseData.gd - 17-joint OpenPose skeleton data structure
